ns2:course.label: Directed Research
ns2:course.description: Nature and scope of projects to be determined by consultation between student and faculty advisor; open to architecture and landscape architecture majors as well as those from other disciplines who wish to engage in interdisciplinary work. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 12 hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 18 hours. MARCH students are limited to 12 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
